```{r variables_and_prep, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# --- Variables for B25047 (Plumbing) ---
b25047_vars <- function() {
  c(total   = "B25047_001",
    complete= "B25047_002",
    lacking = "B25047_003")
}

# --- Fetch for a geography with optional state filter for county/place ---
fetch_plumbing_data <- function(geo,
                                year   = params$data_year,
                                survey = params$survey,
                                states = params$states,
                                with_geometry = TRUE) {
  vars <- b25047_vars()
  base_args <- list(
    variables   = vars,
    year        = year,
    survey      = survey,
    cache_table = TRUE,
    output      = "wide",
    geometry    = with_geometry && (geo != "us")
  )

  if (geo %in% c("us","state")) {
    df <- do.call(get_acs, c(list(geography = geo), base_args))
  } else if (geo %in% c("county","place")) {
    if (is.null(states)) {
      df <- do.call(get_acs, c(list(geography = geo), base_args))
    } else {
      df <- map_dfr(states, \(st) {
        do.call(get_acs, c(list(geography = geo, state = st), base_args))
      })
    }
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported geography: ", geo)
  }

  # Standardize and tidy names
  df %>%
    janitor::clean_names() %>%
    # Tidycensus wide output suffixes: E for estimate, M for MOE
    rename(
      total    = total_e,   total_moe    = total_m,
      complete = complete_e,complete_moe = complete_m,
      lacking  = lacking_e, lacking_moe  = lacking_m
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # MOE-aware share calculations
      pct_complete = complete / total,
      pct_complete_moe = moe_prop(
        num = complete, denom = total,
        moe_num = complete_moe, moe_denom = total_moe
      ),
      pct_lacking = lacking / total,
      pct_lacking_moe = moe_prop(
        num = lacking, denom = total,
        moe_num = lacking_moe, moe_denom = total_moe
      ),
      name_clean = str_squish(name)
    ) %>%
    # Handy state_name for county/place (parsed from "County, State")
    mutate(
      state_name = if (geo %in% c("county", "place"))
        sub(".*,\\s*", "", name_clean) else NA_character_
    )
}


# --- Ranking & percentiles helper ---
add_ranks_percentiles <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      complete_rank = rank(desc(complete), ties.method = "min"),
      lacking_rank  = rank(desc(lacking),  ties.method = "min")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pct_complete_percentile = ntile(pct_complete, 100),
      pct_lacking_percentile  = ntile(pct_lacking, 100)
    )
}

```

```{r more_functions, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, include = FALSE}

# --- Barplot with MOE error bars (percentage complete) ---
plot_bar_with_moe <- function(df, label_col = "name_clean",
                              title = "Share with complete plumbing",
                              subtitle = NULL) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(.data[[label_col]], pct_complete),
                 y = pct_complete)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(pct_complete - pct_complete_moe, 0),
                      ymax = pmin(pct_complete + pct_complete_moe, 1)),
                  width = 0.35, linewidth = 0.6) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = NULL, y = "Percent with complete plumbing",
      caption = glue("Source: ACS {params$data_year} {params$survey} • {params$analyst_credit}")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}

# --- Choropleth map helper (requires geometry) ---
plot_choropleth <- function(sf_df, value_col = "pct_lacking",
                            fill_label = "% lacking",
                            title = "Lacking complete plumbing",
                            crs = params$crs_map) {
  stopifnot(inherits(sf_df, "sf"))
  ggdata <- st_transform(sf_df, crs)
  ggplot(ggdata) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[value_col]]), linewidth = 0) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(label = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      fill = fill_label,
      caption = glue("Source: ACS {params$data_year} {params$survey} • {params$analyst_credit}")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}

# --- CSV & GeoJSON writers ---
write_outputs <- function(df, stem, write_geojson = TRUE) {
  # CSV (drop geometry if present)
  csv_df <- df
  if (inherits(csv_df, "sf")) csv_df <- st_drop_geometry(csv_df)
  readr::write_csv(csv_df, file.path(params$out_dir, "csv", glue("{stem}.csv")))

  # GeoJSON (if sf + requested)
  if (write_geojson && inherits(df, "sf")) {
    out_path <- file.path(params$out_dir, "geojson", glue("{stem}.geojson"))
    st_write(st_transform(df, 4326), out_path, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  }
}
```

```{r variables_and_prep, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, include = FALSE}

us_df <- if ("us" %in% params$geos) {
  fetch_plumbing_data("us", with_geometry = FALSE) %>%
    add_ranks_percentiles()
} else NULL

if (!is.null(us_df)) {
  # One row (nation); show headline stats
  us_row <- us_df %>% slice(1)
  kable(us_row %>%
          transmute(
            total_housing_units = total,
            pct_complete = pct_complete,
            pct_complete_moe = pct_complete_moe,
            pct_lacking = pct_lacking,
            pct_lacking_moe = pct_lacking_moe
          ) %>%
          mutate(across(starts_with("pct_"),
                        ~ scales::percent(., accuracy = 0.1))),
        caption = "United States – plumbing access (ACS 5-year)",
        align = "r") %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

  # Save data
  write_outputs(us_df, glue("b25047_us_{params$data_year}"), write_geojson = FALSE)
}
```

```{r cars}


state_df <- if ("state" %in% params$geos) {
  fetch_plumbing_data("state", with_geometry = TRUE) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(name_clean, "Puerto Rico")) %>%
    add_ranks_percentiles()
} else NULL

if (!is.null(state_df)) {
  # Bar chart with MOE
  states_barplot <- plot_bar_with_moe(
    state_df,
    title = "Percentage of housing units with complete plumbing (States + D.C.)",
    subtitle = glue("ACS {params$data_year} 5-year; error bars are 90% MOE")
  )
  states_barplot

  # Map (% lacking)
  if (isTRUE(params$make_maps)) {
    state_map <- plot_choropleth(
      state_df, value_col = "pct_lacking",
      fill_label = "% lacking",
      title = glue("Share lacking complete plumbing – States + D.C. (ACS {params$data_year})")
    )
    state_map
    ggsave(file.path(params$out_dir, "maps",
                     glue("map_states_pct_lacking_{params$data_year}.png")),
           state_map, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  }

  # Save data & GeoJSON
  write_outputs(state_df, glue("b25047_state_{params$data_year}"), write_geojson = TRUE)

  # Top/bottom overview
  top_state <- state_df %>% slice_max(pct_complete, n = 1)
  bottom_state <- state_df %>% slice_min(pct_complete, n = 1)

  cat(glue("
**State highlight**  
• Highest share complete: {top_state$name_clean} ({scales::percent(top_state$pct_complete, 0.1)} ± {scales::percent(top_state$pct_complete_moe, 0.1)})  
• Lowest share complete: {bottom_state$name_clean} ({scales::percent(bottom_state$pct_complete, 0.1)} ± {scales::percent(bottom_state$pct_complete_moe, 0.1)})
"))
}
```

```{r cars}


county_df <- if ("county" %in% params$geos) {
  fetch_plumbing_data("county", with_geometry = TRUE) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(name_clean, "Puerto Rico")) %>%
    add_ranks_percentiles()
} else NULL

if (!is.null(county_df)) {
  # Summary tables
  kable(
    county_df %>%
      arrange(desc(pct_complete)) %>%
      select(name_clean, state_name, total, pct_complete, pct_complete_moe) %>%
      head(15) %>%
      mutate(across(starts_with("pct_"), ~ scales::percent(., 0.1))),
    caption = "Top 15 counties by percent with complete plumbing",
    align = "r"
  ) %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

  kable(
    county_df %>%
      arrange(pct_complete) %>%
      select(name_clean, state_name, total, pct_complete, pct_complete_moe) %>%
      head(15) %>%
      mutate(across(starts_with("pct_"), ~ scales::percent(., 0.1))),
    caption = "Bottom 15 counties by percent with complete plumbing",
    align = "r"
  ) %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

  # Bar chart example (bottom 30 by pct_complete)
  counties_bottom30_plot <- plot_bar_with_moe(
    county_df %>%
      arrange(pct_complete) %>% slice_head(n = 30),
    title = "Counties with lowest share of complete plumbing (Bottom 30)",
    subtitle = glue("ACS {params$data_year} 5-year; error bars = 90% MOE")
  )
  counties_bottom30_plot

  # Map (% lacking)
  if (isTRUE(params$make_maps)) {
    county_map <- plot_choropleth(
      county_df, value_col = "pct_lacking",
      fill_label = "% lacking",
      title = glue("Share lacking complete plumbing – Counties (ACS {params$data_year})")
    )
    county_map
    ggsave(file.path(params$out_dir, "maps",
                     glue("map_counties_pct_lacking_{params$data_year}.png")),
           county_map, width = 10.5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  }

  # Save data & GeoJSON
  write_outputs(county_df, glue("b25047_county_{params$data_year}"), write_geojson = TRUE)

  # Percentile quick counts
  pct100_cty <- county_df %>% filter(pct_complete_percentile == 100) %>% nrow()
  pct001_cty <- county_df %>% filter(pct_complete_percentile == 1) %>% nrow()
  cat(glue("\nCounties in 100th percentile (best): {pct100_cty}\n"))
  cat(glue("Counties in 1st percentile (lowest): {pct001_cty}\n"))
}
```
